svg.title: Steiermark (Styria) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Styria; 2: Gamlitz; 3: Leutschach; 4: Kitzeck im Sausal; 5: Klöch; 6: Kapfenstein; 7: Straden; 8: Stainz; 9: Deutschlandsberg; 10: Graz

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
